purpose: Unique service-relevant hero photos for every city service page, with shared imagery only between language counterparts.
origin: Original AI-generated illustrative photography; not records of completed client projects or exact photographed locations.

visual_variations.toronto: Contemporary dense urban business setting where relevant; wide establishing composition, overcast daylight, subject right, grey and warm oak materials.
visual_variations.mississauga: Modern suburban business setting where relevant; three-quarter close-to-medium composition, soft morning light, subject left, light concrete and blue-grey accents.
visual_variations.north-york: Older mixed-use commercial setting where relevant; medium-detail composition from a lower camera height, diffused light, brick and neutral textures.
visual_variations.vaughan: Newer industrial or commercial business setting where relevant; medium-wide diagonal composition, late-afternoon light, centred subject, steel and pale stone textures.

constraints: One distinct scene per page pair
No logos, readable text or watermarks
No claims of exact location or completed projects
English and French counterparts use the same photo
regeneration: The build refreshes page image references from the route manifests. Keep originals separate from generic service images. Do not reintroduce old srcset references.
